review_rule.definition: One completed independent candidate with no measurable reproducible improvement after the most recently accepted change. Inconclusive repeats of the same candidate count once. Blend-state filtering was rejected after 0444.
review_rule.counter_note: A measurement-only patch does not reset the performance rejection count. The four slot masks and one scheduler model are independent candidates. Superseded incorrect matrix trial is tracked while its repaired candidate is under comparison.
review_rule.counter_note_0469_metrics: The two dismissals of 2026-11-27 (TBDR default, constant-index WideLoads) were not implemented and are not counted, as for the earlier dismissals by analysis. The 0469 compile and harness fixes are measurement-only and do not reset or add to the count.
review_rule.counter_note_in_pass_cut: The in-pass cut axis was a measurement without a candidate patch (no cut-rule change attempted): it neither resets nor adds to the count.

excluded_experiments: Per-frame clearing of borrowed resource tables: the exploratory analysis consulted a personal archive in conflict with the autonomous input constraint. All candidate patches, timings and prioritization from that investigation are excluded.

measurement_changes.note: Replay metrics: 5 runs per variant in rotating order, per-draw trace (RBM_TRACE), state digest over the record slots each call reads; engine compile of the two 0469 guards in run 45982852470.

Replay metrics count total cuts and in-pass cuts per frame and print the wall time of each measured frame (submit to queue finish); replay_compare.py reports the paired change against the baseline of the same round; cut variants DM_NVN_CUT=0/16/4; the CI step runs 12 rounds.

layer_rotation_review: iOS front adapter creates one layer and reuses it even across a display switch. No evidence of layer-object rotation as a steady-state iPhone performance bottleneck. Mac replacement and device mutation differ; do not assume an old residencySet can be recovered from the layer after a device change.

homebrew_translation_0436_vs_0450_vs_046.parity: bit-exact SHA-256 on guest_sha256, spirv_sha256, msl_sha256, resources vs reference-output.json

dismissed_by_analysis.candidate: Restore the argument dirty state saved before the PSO prediction / no-load / coverage scans (pso_predict_rest_, pass_color_unwritten, fz_probe_cov2) instead of args_dirty_all()
dismissed_by_analysis.why_not_done: args_dirty_all bumps 0464's monotonic per-slot generation clocks; restoring older generations would reuse values that per-shader snapshots compare against. Runs only at pipeline misses (at most a few per submission), not in steady frames. Needs an engine Metal test that counts re-encoded slots with an A/B switch inside one CI run before any change.

dismissed_by_analysis.candidate: Engine Metal A/B test counting re-encoded argument slots after pso_predict_rest_ (args_dirty_all), as the next axis of the 0469 cycle
dismissed_by_analysis.why_not_done: Bound: args_dirty_all after a lookahead forces at most one fully dirty argument/vertex-buffer encode of the draw at hand per lookahead (0465 bench: 16 dirty vertex buffers cost 51 ns per draw; M03 argument walk in the same range), while the lookahead itself replays state_op for every remaining op of the submission and runs only at pipeline misses. The rebind share is below one replayed op per remaining op and cannot reach a measurable fraction; changing the 0464 clocks carries correctness risk for no measurable gain. Closed without code change; not counted as a rejection.

dismissed_by_analysis.candidate: Faster internal slot hash for long nvn_hmap keys (184 / 344-byte pipeline keys)
dismissed_by_analysis.measure: hm_parts.c, Linux x86, CPU 0, 3 runs: hash 16-25 ns (184 B) / 26-28 ns (344 B), lookup 34-41 ns / 49-53 ns
dismissed_by_analysis.why_not_done: These lookups happen when pipeline state changes, about once per draw at most: even halving the hash saves a few microseconds per frame. 8-byte lookups (about 15 ns on this host, two cache lines a probe) would need keys and values interleaved, but 72 engine sites read m->keys / m->vals directly.

Runs 45969449378, 45971054149 and 45972678814 (0469 replay lab) failed on the paravirtual GPU: no MTLResidencySet, then supportsPlacementSparse throwing through valueForKey. 0469 now routes the missing set through S2A_NO_RESIDENCY_SET (MDIE by default) and reads the property under @try. Replay state digest was unstable in runs 45974878139 and 45982852470 because it mixed record slots the call does not read (RO_R_DRAW a[3..7], high words of float slots) left over from reused record blocks: a harness bug, not an engine effect. Fixed in 0dbe4056d (run 45986463824).

Run 45991888494: the baseline showed 0 in-pass cuts in 12/12 runs (the 2 of 30 earlier runs were timing-dependent). Frame wall time submit-to-finish on the paravirtual GPU has a paired IQR of tens of percent for every switch, including switches that change nothing but call dispatch (rec_imp_off): it detects only large regressions, not the cost of one cut.
